verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own AI produces insights from the user's email data inside the product. Instant Summaries appear at the top of every thread, and the AI Assistant reads threads, searches the full email history and analyzes attached files. Ghostwriter offers inline drafting suggestions based on the user's past emails, and one-click triage identifies important emails and todos. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI insight features (the community evidence predates or doesn't discuss them).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Instant Summaries show up at the very top of your email threads the instant you open them.
it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more.
Read, summarize, and analyze PDF, text, code, and other file types with the AI Assistant
These AI suggestions are intelligent and based on previous emails you've written, so they sound just like you
Identify important emails & todos with a single click.
